headline: Cómo haces proyectos tan diversos?
content: Supongo que siempre he querido ser capaz de desarrollarme profesionalmente, de estar desarrollándome profesionally. Creo que la diversificación me mantiene motivado. Tom Hiddleston, actor de 32 años.  Realmente disfruto este proceso. Puedo aprender muchas diferentes habilidades de cada proyecto. Jamás me he impuesto límites en mi carrera. Los actores hacen sus mejores elecciones cuando tienen la libertad de hacerlo, y algunas veces parece que siguen algún gran diseño, pese a que realmente nada está planeado.  ¿Has imaginado trabajar simultáneamente en varios proyectos? Supongo que siempre he querido poder desarrollarme profesionalmente. Creo que la diversificación me mantiene motivado. Solamente tomé un solo día libre después de rodar Only Lovers Left Alive (dirigida por Jim Jarmusch) y empezar a preparar Thor 2. Cambió rápidamente mis planes. Subí al Avión para volar fuera de Marrakech, llegué a casa, colgué mis ropas en la secadora y al siguiente día...  ...Se gastaron más de mil millones de dólares en el presupuesto de Thor 2.

headline: Thor 2: un mundo oscuro
content: [Detalles de programación]  En esta entrevista también discutimos cómo trabaja actualmente en la adaptación teatral de la obra shakespeariana Coriolanus, menciona haber estado involucrado durante unos cuatro meses, culminando mediados de febrero. Considera emocionante interpretar roles variados, mencionando específicamente pasar de Thor a Shakespeare, añadiendo humor mientras reflexiona sobre qué preferiría: vivir experiencias con Tilda Swinton o Chris Hemsworth. Además, muestra interés genuino hacia el debate académico sobre quién escribió verdaderamente las obras atribuidas a William Shakespeare, revelando su profundo aprecio personal por estas piezas literarias clásicas.

headline: El ciberdelito se mueve hacia otros dispositivos
content: For 2014, cyber attacks will reach smart TVs and other devices. How can we improve our security online? The increasing threats to privacy online include more sophisticated attacks aimed at smartphones and cybercriminals eager to exploit emerging technologies such as Smart TVs and connected cars. This concerning outlook for cybersecurity next year both domestically and regionally has been highlighted by the Latin American branch of antivirus company ESET in its annual report. According to Andre Goujon, specialist in awareness and research at ESET Latin America, there will be increasingly complex smartphone attacks.

headline: Pleno decide si se investiga a Keiko
content: Todays debate concerns whether Congress should initiate a special investigation regarding alleged illegal financial contributions received during Keiko Fujimori’s presidential campaign in 2011. This decision comes after a motion proposed by Action Popular-Front Broad which suggests discussing it further within the full assembly. Legislators have suggested forming a group similar to those used in cases like Ecoteva, tasked specifically with investigating under what circumstances Force 2011 accepted funds from businessman Luis Calle Quiroz, accused in the US of laundering money linked to Colombian drug cartels.

headline: Megacomisión pide prórroga de 45 días
content: Yesterday, the commission overseeing investigations related to former President Alan García requested a 45-day extension before presenting their final report initially scheduled for November 15th. Due to recent court rulings affecting parts of the inquiry against leader Alejandro Toledano, preliminary reports had to be reconsidered particularly involving issues like Business Track (BTR), Water For All, and ‘Drug Indulgence’. Some findings may determine criminal responsibility while others remain informative. It remains undecided whether former officials would need recalling for testimonies.

headline: Actitud de Nadine Heredia frente a políticas sociales
content: First Lady Nadine Heredia stated yesterday that current government programs are now more efficient and transparent compared to previous administrations. She emphasized ongoing efforts to correct past inefficiencies and ensure political neutrality in program administration. During the closing ceremony of the Fifth International Cancer Control Conference held in Lima, she reiterated priorities focusing directly on previously underserved populations who were misled rather than helped by prior initiatives.

headline: Preocupación de ADEX por niveles de competitividad
content: Concerning Perus declining competitiveness rankings according to global indices including the World Economic Forum where Peru ranks 61st—a drop of twenty positions—and Doing Business index showing reduced ease in international trade due to high import costs—the head of exporters association proposes strategic leadership changes led by President Humala to enhance national competitive strategies through realignment back towards Presidential oversight over economic councils.

headline: Avances significativos en turismo hotelero
content: With significant growth rates recorded last year, the hospitality industry seeks increased occupancy levels especially for five-star hotels amidst infrastructure challenges. Hotels aim to attract larger events internationally requiring improved transport solutions alongside enhanced service offerings following extensive renovations incorporating modern technology investments totaling millions USD.

headline: Impacto viral de una fotografía comprometedora...
content: Six months post-Boston Marathon bombing tragedy, young Michigan resident Alicia Ann Lynch faced job termination and harassment across digital platforms upon sharing controversial photos depicting herself dressed up as a marathon attack survivor. Despite receiving death threats and having personal information leaked publicly, Lynch expressed indifference about future employment prospects citing newfound popularity potentially aiding career shifts despite facing severe backlash highlighting societal consequences stemming from irresponsible internet behavior.

headline: Silvio Berlusconi se victimiza
content: Former Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi claims his children feel persecuted akin to Jews under Nazi rule amid Senate deliberations considering stripping him off parliamentary immunity owing to corruption charges. His statements reflect broader sentiments of being targeted universally—an assertion made evident ahead of upcoming book releases detailing internal discussions between key figures involved in Italys governance dynamics.
